issues_detected.title: after_commit lacks defensive checks
issues_detected.root_cause: session._changes may not exist or be of expected type; accessing it raises exceptions.

issues_detected.title: Shared mutable state on global db.session
issues_detected.root_cause: Code attached _changes directly on db.session, which is shared and not session-thread safe.

issues_detected.title: Index updates not atomic
issues_detected.root_cause: INDEX append operations are unprotected and may interleave across threads.

issues_detected.title: Incomplete test coverage
issues_detected.root_cause: Tests didn't cover missing/leftover states, rollbacks, or session isolation race scenarios.

issues_detected.title: Global event binding
issues_detected.root_cause: Event listeners were attached to a global db.session instead of per-Session listeners leading to unpredictable behavior.

code_changes_summary: Implemented session.info-based per-session change tracking, added defensive checks, ensured cleanup after commit/rollback, used SQLAlchemy Session event hooks for session-level binding, added atomic indexing via a lock, and extended tests to cover concurrency and cleanup cases.
